previous_statement: Let (delta,S_grp,u_grp,h_grp) denote the polar datum whose inverse first component u_grp is the u_delta used in lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws, and let (delta,S_pol,u_pol,h_pol) be the explicit polar datum supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction in 1.7.4. These are two polar data in the sense required by lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality: in each case Pi_delta has source calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), formula (U,H) |-> U bold-dot H, and inverse (u,h).
new_statement: The exact allowed contracts do not supply a second polar datum attached to u_grp. lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws provides a function u_grp described only as the inverse of the polar map and the resulting C^1 group-law conclusions; it provides no target S_grp, companion h_grp, typed bijection for Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H, or inverse identities. lem-stage1-polar-retraction supplies the sole fully typed datum (delta,S_delta,u_pol,h_pol). Therefore the two-datum hypothesis of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality cannot be instantiated with u_grp; applying coherence to the retraction datum twice is tautological and does not imply u_grp=u_pol. Thus the asserted synchronization step is unavailable from the exact allowed inputs.
